explanation: Julius Caesar was made dictator for life, then assassinated in 44 BC. His adopted heir Octavian took the name Augustus in 27 BC and ruled as emperor.

claims.text: Augustus, formerly Octavian, became the first Roman emperor in 27 BC.
Julius Caesar was dictator but never emperor, and Nero and Constantine ruled later.
Julius Caesar was named dictator for life and was assassinated in 44 BC.
Octavian was Julius Caesar's adopted heir and took the name Augustus in 27 BC.
